notes: The supplied object pronoun *them* at t024 was folded into בְּנֵי as a rule 25 resumption, while the same gapped-object pronoun is marked `added` at 1SA.8.12, 1SA.8.14 and 1SA.8.16. Rule 44 is what governs a supplied object pronoun: the coordinated clause וְשָׂם לוֹ writes no object morpheme, the Hebrew gapping the object of שָׂם, so nothing in that clause answers to the word. Rule 25's resumption reaches a pronoun supplied where a clause writes no subject of its own, or a second realization of one written phrase, and a noun already rendered as the object of its own verb is not a home for a second English word, as rule 51 says of a waw. *them* becomes its own `added` unit and בְּנֵי keeps only *sons*.
